form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Typed fillable form, printed and scanned via CamScanner (a 'Scanned with CamScanner' watermark sits in the bottom-right of both pages). The Office field is the one HANDWRITTEN field on the cover, in block capitals: 'UTAH COUNTY COMMISSION SEAT B' (index.csv 'County Commission Seat B' - agrees). Street address, phone number and signature are redacted upstream by the county; the printed city 'Spanish Fork, UT 84660' and the email survive. Summary figures are typed without dollar signs and without thousands separators. PAGE-COUNT INCONSISTENCY inside the filing: the cover's Page box reads '1 of 7' while the summary page's reads '8 of 8' (the PDF has 8 pages) - the filer's own numbering, recorded not corrected. Cover prints the filing address as 'disclosures@utahcounty.gov'.

contributions.note: City/state read from the 'City and Zip Code' column AFTER the county's redaction bar. The filer typed a full street address into that column and the clerk blacked out its left portion, so what survives is a street FRAGMENT followed by the city, state and zip; only the city and state are carried and no fragment of the street is recorded anywhere. donor_state is present because this filer typed the state into the cell even though the column heading asks only for city and zip. First row of the filing's first Schedule A sheet; the amount is printed as a bare '100' with no decimal — this filer writes whole dollars with no cents throughout, and the figures are kept exactly as printed.

contributions.detail: FOUR Schedule A sheets, each gated separately against its own printed 'Subtotal for this page' before the grand total was tested (the ADDENDUM L2 discipline). PDF p2 = 15 rows summing 3,250.00 = its printed $3250. PDF p3 = 15 rows summing 3,037.00 = its printed $3037. PDF p4 = 15 rows summing 42,942.96 = its printed $42942.96. PDF p5 = 4 rows summing 3,570.00 = its printed $3570. 3250 + 3037 + 42942.96 + 3570 = 52,799.96 = the sum-of-all-pages total printed on every sheet = the promoted per-period Box B. Box C (Year to Date) prints the identical 52,799.96 and is NOT summed as an increment; Box A is 0 and Box F (A + B) prints 52,799.96, so period == year-to-date because this is the cycle's first report. 49 rows in all. The one cents-bearing contribution (317.96) is what makes the .96 in every printed total, so the closure is a genuine test and not a round-number coincidence.
